html: This page is generated from one file per entry in the repository, with the tab counts computed. Separate entry files preserve each change's source; the generated page may need to be regenerated when branches are combined. A check refuses a page that is not a fresh render of its entries, and a published change must add an entry file in its category's tab rather than edit this page by hand; specification, schema, code-list, example and validator changes also need a dated entry in the repository changelog.
